locator: I q.3 a.5 co., third proof: omnia quae sunt in genere uno ... differant in eis esse et quod quid est
interpretation: Prose source reading only, including the proposed conclusion and its rationale rather than claiming the argument is established. Sharing generic quiddity does not by definition identify each individual’s complete essence with that genus. This extra metaphysical account is not already a consequence of the current strict-predication clauses.
